svg.title: Base Case: $445,000 Revenue to $189,125 Owner Profit
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-owner-profit-waterfall; chart type: waterfall; title: Base Case: $445,000 Revenue to $189,125 Owner Profit; subtitle: Four expense deductions reconcile exactly to a 42.5% annual net margin.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: USD annually. The first and last bars are absolute totals; the four intervening bars are negative deltas. Expense allocations are illustrative and reconcile to the canonical scorecard. Revenue is already net of upstream retained-share deductions.; caption: $445,000 − $110,000 − $78,000 − $59,875 − $8,000 = $189,125; $189,125 / $445,000 = 42.5%.; stages: label: Retained operator revenue; value: $445,000 annual starting total; numeric value: 445000.0; detail: Base revenue comprises $375,000 retained merchant and gateway income plus $70,000 retained ATM surcharge income. Merchant card volume and vault cash contribute zero revenue.; label: Acquisition commissions; value: Subtract $110,000 annual sales expense; numeric value: -110000.0; detail: Pay operator-side referral and sales compensation under documented schedules. These costs are distinct from processor and venue shares already removed from revenue.; label: Contract servicing; value: Subtract $78,000 annual delivery expense; numeric value: -78000.0; detail: Fund contractor boarding, residual auditing, dispute operations, and ATM field-service work; the full-time owner's compensation is not deducted again from owner profit.; label: Fixed operating overhead; value: Subtract $59,875 annual overhead expense; numeric value: -59875.0; detail: Budget CRM, telemetry, insurance, equipment leases, bookkeeping, and administration. Average fixed overhead is $4,989.58 monthly; total expenses also include variable costs.; label: Loss and remediation expense; value: Subtract $8,000 annual risk expense; numeric value: -8000.0; detail: Model operator-borne losses and remediation costs under the relevant contracts. Restricted reserve deposits are not automatically expenses, and recoverable vault cash is excluded.; label: Annual owner net profit; value: $189,125 ending total; 42.5% margin; numeric value: 189125.0; detail: Canonical checks: Conservative $90,000 times 30% equals $27,000; Base $445,000 times 42.5% equals $189,125; Scaled $800,000 times 55% equals $440,000.

text.title: Base Case: $445,000 Revenue to $189,125 Owner Profit
text.tspan: Base Case: $445,000 Revenue to $189,125 Owner Profit

circle.title: label: Retained operator revenue; value: $445,000 annual starting total; numeric value: 445000.0; detail: Base revenue comprises $375,000 retained merchant and gateway income plus $70,000 retained ATM surcharge income. Merchant card volume and vault cash contribute zero revenue.

label: Acquisition commissions; value: Subtract $110,000 annual sales expense; numeric value: -110000.0; detail: Pay operator-side referral and sales compensation under documented schedules. These costs are distinct from processor and venue shares already removed from revenue.

label: Contract servicing; value: Subtract $78,000 annual delivery expense; numeric value: -78000.0; detail: Fund contractor boarding, residual auditing, dispute operations, and ATM field-service work; the full-time owner's compensation is not deducted again from owner profit.

label: Fixed operating overhead; value: Subtract $59,875 annual overhead expense; numeric value: -59875.0; detail: Budget CRM, telemetry, insurance, equipment leases, bookkeeping, and administration. Average fixed overhead is $4,989.58 monthly; total expenses also include variable costs.

label: Loss and remediation expense; value: Subtract $8,000 annual risk expense; numeric value: -8000.0; detail: Model operator-borne losses and remediation costs under the relevant contracts. Restricted reserve deposits are not automatically expenses, and recoverable vault cash is excluded.

label: Annual owner net profit; value: $189,125 ending total; 42.5% margin; numeric value: 189125.0; detail: Canonical checks: Conservative $90,000 times 30% equals $27,000; Base $445,000 times 42.5% equals $189,125; Scaled $800,000 times 55% equals $440,000.

text.title: Assumptions: USD annually. The first and last bars are absolute totals; the four intervening bars are negative deltas. Expense allocations are illustrative and reconcile to the canonical scorecard. Revenue is already net of upstream retained-share deductions.
